title: TOEIC 每日練習 Day 30（2026-11-27）
summary: 最新成績仍是 Day 15 的 15/25，Day 16 之後還沒收到交卷。今天繼續加強：leave／find／consider + 受詞 + 形容詞（含 remarkably fast 副詞對照、usage 名詞陷阱），以及閱讀、聽力的「時間與數字干擾」。另外複習 if 子句配 will／could、Despite／Although、comply with、whose／who、be responsible for、on + 日期。聽力今天是 Part 4 電話留言。做完按「交卷」就會自動回傳成績

sections.heading: Part 5 文法與字彙（建議 11 分鐘）
sections.tip: leave／find／consider + 受詞 + 空格：描述受詞用形容詞（very 後面也是形容詞）；空格後面若還有形容詞，空格就是副詞。假設語氣先看主要子句：will 配 if 現在式，would／could 配 if 過去式。Although 接句子，Despite 接名詞。日期用 on。

qs.stem: If the client ------- the contract today, we will start the project next week.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 will start ＝ 真實可能發生。2. if 子句用現在式，the client 單數用 signs。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: If we ------- a bigger budget, we could hire two more engineers.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 could hire ＝ 與現在事實相反（其實預算不夠）。2. if 子句用過去式 had。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: Please leave the windows ------- during the cleaning.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. leave + 受詞（the windows）+ 空格，描述窗戶的狀態。2. 狀態用形容詞 open（開著的）。3. 選 A。

qs.stem: Customers found the new checkout system ------- fast.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. find + 受詞 + 空格 + fast。2. 空格後已經有形容詞 fast，空格修飾 fast，用副詞 remarkably。3. 選 B。口訣：空格後還有形容詞 → 副詞；沒有 → 形容詞。

qs.stem: The manager considers the new software very -------.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. consider + 受詞（the new software）+ very + 空格。2. very 後面接形容詞，而且後面沒有其他形容詞 → useful。3. 選 B。usage 是名詞，usefully 是副詞。

qs.stem: ------- the heavy traffic, Mr. Lee arrived at the meeting on time.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. the heavy traffic 是名詞片語，沒有動詞。2. 讓步接名詞用介系詞 Despite。3. 選 B。Although／Even though 要接句子。

qs.stem: ------- the printer is old, it still works well.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後有主詞 the printer＋動詞 is，是句子。2. 讓步接句子用 Although。3. 選 C。

qs.stem: All employees are required to comply ------- the new travel policy.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：comply with ＝ 遵守。看到 comply 直接選 with。

qs.stem: The company hired a designer ------- work has won several awards.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後先出現名詞 work，再接動詞 has won。2. 「那位設計師『的』作品」。3. 選 whose。

qs.stem: Mr. Park is responsible ------- training new staff members.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. be responsible for ＝ 負責。2. 選 B。對照：be in charge of 用 of，別混。

qs.stem: The annual sales conference will be held ------- January 14.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 日期用 on；時刻用 at；月份、年份用 in。2. January 14 是日期，選 C。

sections.heading: Part 7 短篇閱讀（建議 9 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先讀題目、圈關鍵字（Why、When、Where、NOT），再回原文找那一句。from…until 是關閉期間，start again 才是恢復；房號和分機號碼都是干擾；instead of 前面是新地點。
passage: To: All staff ／ From: Facilities Office ／ Subject: Cafeteria Kitchen Upgrade
The second-floor cafeteria will be closed from Tuesday, December 1, until Friday, December 4, while new ovens are installed. Normal service will start again on Monday, December 7.
During this time, lunch will be served in Meeting Room 210 instead of the cafeteria, from 11:30 A.M. to 1:30 P.M.
Coffee will also be provided free of charge in the lobby. Questions can be sent to extension 425.

qs.stem: Why was the e-mail sent?
opts: To announce a temporary change in lunch service
To invite staff to a cooking class
To ask staff to order new ovens
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 目的題看主旨和第一句：cafeteria will be closed … new ovens are installed。2. 午餐服務暫時改變 ＝ temporary change in lunch service。3. 選 A。C 偷用 ovens，是重複字陷阱。

qs.stem: When will the cafeteria return to normal service?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Normal service will start again on Monday, December 7。2. A 是開始關閉日；B 是關閉期間最後一天（until），都是時間干擾。3. 選 C。

qs.stem: Where will lunch be served during the upgrade?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. lunch will be served in Meeting Room 210 instead of the cafeteria。2. instead of 前面是新地點，後面是舊地點（陷阱）。3. C 用分機 425 混淆；D 是咖啡的地點。選 B。

qs.stem: What is NOT mentioned in the e-mail?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. NOT 題：逐一核對。2. new ovens、free of charge（＝ free）、11:30–1:30 原文都有。3. 原文沒提停車費，選 D。

sections.heading: Part 2 聽力應答（建議 6 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先聽清楚第一個字（Why don't we／or／When／Didn't／Who／How long）。建議句不選 Because；A or B 問句和 Wh 問句不選 Yes。重複題目的字或發音相近的字（coffee／copy、order 一字多義）通常是陷阱。

qs.stem: Why don't we take a taxi to the airport?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Why don't we…? ＝ 建議「我們何不……」。2. B 接受建議。3. A 是 Because 陷阱；C 用 take／took 相近字陷阱。

qs.stem: Would you like tea or coffee?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. A or B 選擇疑問句，先刪 Yes。2. B 選咖啡。3. C 用 coffee／copy 發音相近陷阱。

qs.stem: When does the workshop start?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. When 問時間。2. A 回答時間。3. B 是地點且重複 workshop；C 用 workshop／shop 陷阱。

qs.stem: Didn't you order more envelopes?
opts: An envelope is on the desk.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 把 not 拿掉：Did you order more envelopes?。2. A「有，星期一會到」。3. B 用 order 一字多義陷阱（順序）；C 重複 envelope。

qs.stem: Who will pick up the visitors from the station?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Who 問人。2. B 回答人。3. A 是 Yes 陷阱又重複 pick；C 重複 station。

qs.stem: How long will the repair take?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. How long 問多久。2. A「大約兩小時」。3. B 重複 long；C 重複 take。

sections.heading: Part 4 電話留言（建議 4 分鐘）
sections.tip: 播放前先讀三題，圈出 Why、When、asked to do。留言會出現原本時間和新時間，選 instead 前面的新時間；小心星期和時刻混搭的選項。return my call ＝ call back。
script: Hello, this is Karen from Brightline Office Supplies, calling for Mr. David Chen.
I'm calling about the desks you ordered. We planned to deliver them on Wednesday at ten A.M., but our truck needs repairs.
So we'd like to deliver them on Friday at two P.M. instead. Our driver will call you about thirty minutes before arriving.
If Friday doesn't work for you, please return my call at 555-0172 before five o'clock today. Thank you.

qs.stem: Why is the speaker calling?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 目的題聽開頭：I'm calling about the desks … but our truck needs repairs, so … deliver on Friday instead。2. 改送貨時間，選 A。

qs.stem: When will the desks most likely be delivered?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. deliver them on Friday at two P.M. instead。2. A 是原本時間；B、C 是新舊時間混搭干擾。3. instead 前面是新時間，選 D。

qs.stem: What is Mr. Chen asked to do if Friday is not convenient?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 最後：please return my call。2. return a call ＝ call back（換句話說）。3. 選 B。
